metadata.description: Claude skills for academic research: methodology, scientific writing, examination, and OpenResearch autoresearch.

plugins.name: design-science-research
plugins.description: Design Science Research (DSR) expert: planning, processes (DSRM, ADR, Wieringa, Dresch et al.), design principles and theories, FEDS evaluation, paper and thesis writing, and manuscript review.

plugins.name: cs-phd-thesis-evaluation
plugins.description: Expert examiner for computer science PhD theses: calibrated assessment against the doctoral standard, claims-to-evidence verification, subfield checklists, integrity checks, examiner and pre-defense reports, defense questions, corrections verification, and mock examinations across examination systems.

plugins.name: openresearch-cli
plugins.description: Use the orx CLI to run local OpenResearch projects from a terminal — create experiment branches, launch and supervise compute, inspect logs and evidence, and manage the experiment tree.

plugins.name: orx-agent-delegation
plugins.description: Delegate independent work to helper agent sessions with orx agent spawn: task selection, self-contained briefs, branch ownership, compute authorization, and concurrency constraints.

plugins.name: orx-compute
plugins.description: Launch and monitor experiment runs and route guidance for HF, Modal, Kubernetes, SSH, Slurm, Ray, OpenResearch, Tinker, and local backends with fixed run contracts.

plugins.name: orx-create
plugins.description: Initialize an OpenResearch project with orx up and add experiment nodes with orx create-experiment for baselines, parent nodes, and run commands.

plugins.name: orx-customize
plugins.description: Save reusable skills and LaTeX templates with orx skills add and orx templates add for use across OpenResearch projects.

plugins.name: orx-evidence
plugins.description: Prepare and inspect experiment run evidence: design stdout metrics and summaries, read persisted results with orx logs, and validate run-derived claims.

plugins.name: orx-experiment-tree
plugins.description: Plan and drive the experiment tree: first-launch setup, fixed run contract, frozen nodes, stacked-bush tree shape, branch/launch/wait/promote, and turn summaries.

plugins.name: orx-figures
plugins.description: Publication-quality figures in matplotlib or TikZ: learning curves, scaling laws, benchmark and ablation comparisons, Pareto trade-offs, heatmaps, and method diagrams.

plugins.name: orx-git
plugins.description: Read, edit, commit, and diff experiment code; coordinate shared worktrees and preserve frozen branch history across OpenResearch experiment nodes.

plugins.name: orx-instances
plugins.description: Create standalone OpenResearch compute instances with orx instance create for persistent machines and manual or ad-hoc exploration.

plugins.name: orx-lit-review
plugins.description: Search and read research papers across alphaXiv, OpenAlex, and bioRxiv discovery primitives, rank combined candidates, and follow up on sources.

plugins.name: orx-paper
plugins.description: Draft academic papers or preprints as LaTeX in the project working tree with live rendering, compilation checks, and grounding in experiment runs.

plugins.name: orx-reports
plugins.description: Write and organize durable research outputs in the artifacts directory, including reports, summaries, comparisons, figures, and exported data.
